findings.summary: argocd/README.md:7: the README now drops the owner's Access, tunnel and service-token steps and says they live in homelab-infra#230, with `terraform output -raw board_client_id` / `board_client_secret` as the native app's credentials. homelab-infra's own history disagrees. Commit 0c3a9d7 says "#230's apply was refused (403, auth.forbidden) creating the SDLC board's service token", and it is still only on the unmerged branch claude/cloudflare-service-token-permission. In access.tf the board application depends on the board_app policy, and that policy depends on the token. So the AUD in deploy/values.yaml:9 only exists if a later apply worked, and nothing in this repo shows that one did. If it didn't, the owner follows the README and finds no service token. After sync, the cluster's end-to-end check of AC-8 (native app with a service token) fails, and the board_client_id output is missing. Before merge, confirm the apply and the outputs on Omarchy and note it in the PR, or keep a fallback step in the README.

decision: Open the PR and advance to PR review
